===Hide/Show===
I figured out what is bothering me about the [Hide] button (well, one thing). Make the header image/title still show even when it's closed down, and it will be more useful/obvious. -- ''[[User:Nae'blis|nae]]'[[User_talk:Nae'blis|blis]]'' 23:54, 15 September 2006 (UTC)
:When hidden it should be as small as possible; the image will potentially be very tall (such as at [[starwars:yoda]] or [[starwars:palpatine]]).  The name would be doable but  I don't think it would be particularly useful.  It's shown by default, and I figure the first time someone clicks the hide button they'll immediately click show again if they want to see it work. But, if you really want to display the name when hidden, change [[template:slf]] (or perhaps [[template:slh]], depending on how you wan to go about it) --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 00:06, 16 September 2006 (UTC)
